openingMessage: Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
openingWhy: We'll never run a flawless location. But chasing it is how our checks caught an empty SABA and an out-of-hydro bottle this week — before anybody's lungs needed them. Chasing perfect means the flaw gets found in the inspection instead of the emergency.
leadershipThought: Distraction, fatigue, and rushing are the three passengers that never announce themselves. Any one of them alone is a stop condition. Check for all three before the truck moves — not after the first close call.

specialFocus.title: Turtlebox Draw — Excellence Pays Off
specialFocus.why: This morning's highlight: we're giving away a Turtlebox radio, and the only way onto that wheel was the paperwork. Every tech who finished September at 90%+ form compliance — 5 or more audited shifts, straight off Matt's monthly audit — has an equal slot. Twenty-two names made it. Nobody picked favorites and nobody could have: excellence got you on the wheel, and the spin picks the winner where everyone can watch. This is the deal going forward — the scoreboard isn't just accountability, it's a ticket. October's wheel is already filling.
specialFocus.standardLabel: How the Draw Works — Watch It Happen
standard: The pool is data, not opinion: 90%+ September compliance with 5+ audited shifts, per the monthly audit on the Job Forms tab. Every qualifying name is on the wheel below — check it yourself.
Equal slots, visible spin. One tap, seven turns, and the wheel decides in front of the whole circle.
Didn't make the wheel this month? The October pool opened on the 1st — every complete packet, every dated JSA, every trailer form is a step onto next month's wheel.
After the spin: Driving & Journey Management is still the week — run the scenario and get the crews rolling safe.
questions: Twenty-two techs qualified at 90%+. What would it take to make it forty?
specialFocus.nonNegotiable: Excellence gets you in the drawing — luck only ever picks among the people who did the work. October's wheel is filling right now.
